fusions.name: Fed through the Soil
fusions.desc: Your roots feed on every enemy within 2.5 tiles: the draw deals 3 damage to each, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Ripe for Picking
fusions.desc: A harvesting blow that deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Laden Bough
fusions.desc: Restores 15 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Harvest Garland
fusions.desc: Conjures a garland of fruiting branches: your maximum health rises by 15, each kill returns 4 health, your critical chance rises by 4% and your critical hits deal 12% more damage.
